segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Listen to a talk in a business class.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Let's talk about lean manufacturing and its impact on efficiency in production processes.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Lean manufacturing is a systematic approach to minimizing waste within a manufacturing system while maximizing productivity.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: While the methodology has been adopted by many companies worldwide, it was developed by a Japanese carmaker in the mid-20th century.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: But its roots can actually be traced to the supermarket.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: In the 1950s, Japanese engineers observed that supermarkets in the United States only restocked items as customers purchased them, maintaining just enough inventory to meet demand.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: This idea of just-in-time inventory management became a core principle of lean manufacturing.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: By identifying and removing excess inventory and eliminating other inefficiencies, companies could reduce costs and increase their overall productivity.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Another important aspect of lean manufacturing is continuous improvement, often referred to as Kaizen.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: This involves constantly seeking ways to enhance processes, products, and services.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Employees at all levels are encouraged to contribute ideas for improvement, fostering a culture of innovation and teamwork.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Lean manufacturing also emphasizes the importance of value from the customer's perspective.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Companies focus on producing goods that meet customer needs and expectations, ensuring that each step in the production process adds value rather than unnecessary complexity.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: As you might imagine, implementing lean manufacturing requires a shift in organizational culture.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Resistance to change and difficulty in sustaining improvements can get in the way.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: That said, companies that successfully adopt lean practices experience increased efficiency, reduced costs, and higher customer satisfaction.
